header.running_head: The Strength of the Imaan of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.arabic_text: فَاَمَّآ اِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ ۝ فَرَوْحٌ وَّرَيْحَانٌ ۙ وَّجَنَّتُ نَعِيْمٍ
blocks.text: Therefore, if someone was from among those brought close (to Allaah) he shall have comfort, sustenance and the Jannaat of bliss.
At the same time, Allaah loves to meet him even more. On the other hand, he dislikes meeting Allaah and Allaah dislikes meeting him even more when he is told:

blocks.arabic_text: وَاَمَّآ اِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ الضَّآلِّيْنَ ۝ فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيْمٍ ۝ وَّتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيْمٍ
blocks.text: However, if he was among the rejecters and deviated ones, he will be served boiling water and shall enter the blazing fire.[^1]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Weeps when Allaah reveals the verse: "When the earth shall quake most violently"

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr bin Al Aas (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr bin Al Aas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Abu Bakr Siddeeq (RA) was sitting somewhere and started weeping excessively when Allaah revealed the verse:
When the earth shall quake most violently.

"What makes you weep so, O Abu Bakr?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked. "It is this Surah that makes me weep," Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "If you people were such that you neither erred nor sinned so that Allaah could forgive you, Allaah would create a nation that errs and sins just so that He could forgive them."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Informs Hadhrat Umar (RA) About what would Happen in the Grave

Hadhrat Umar (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to him, "O Umar! What would be your condition when you are in a piece of ground measuring four arm's lengths by two arm's lengths and when you see Munkar and Nakeer?" "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "What is Munkar and Nakeer?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "They are the two examiners in the grave. They will dig the grave open with their canines and approach treading on their (extremely long) hairs. Their voices will be like devastating thunderclaps and their eyes like blinding lightning.
